notes.title: Where We're At with Development
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there![/h2][p]The work hasn't stopped. Over the past month, we've done a lot, though a surprising amount of time and energy went into the Steam page itself. (Making the trailer, gifs, and decent-looking screenshots is way harder than it sounds.)

[/p][h3]The big thing[/h3][p] — lighting. I got feedback on the screenshots and trailer — many people didn’t like the lighting, so I redid it. You can already see the updated version in the re-recorded trailer.
I’ll probably need to start a regular development log soon, but before that, I guess I should explain what the current state of development looks like:

[/p][h2] +- Done:[/h2][p]
[/p][list][*][p] Controls: Overall, they're pretty comfortable now. We’re currently finishing up the UI hints.

[/p][/*][*][p] Networking: About 90% complete, excluding the rehost system. Still need to do a bit more with Steam API integration, but everything is not only functional — it's tested. The system is built to handle high ping and packet loss without issues.

[/p][/*][*][p] Cards: All the card artworks are finished, and the code is done and tested for all cards except two. Two more still need visuals for their effects.

[/p][/*][*][p] Visuals: The 3D side — environments, players, etc. — is already in place. As for animations, all the essential skeletal animations are done, implemented, and working. Code-driven animations (card movements, VFX, and so on) are about three-quarters done.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]Less than halfway done:[/h3][p]
[/p][olist][*][p] Sound design (environment, interactions, etc.)

[/p][/*][*][p] UI (images and widgets)
[/p][/*][/olist][p]
That’s the current state.

If anyone's interested, I’ll keep posting updates — and I’ll just be hanging out on Discord too. 
Join here:  [url="https://discord.gg/BmasGNaEgR"]https://discord.gg/BmasGNaEgR[/url] 🤙[/p]
